name: Kao Kang
description: A fast-casual Southern Thai counter inside Wellington Market food hall, by the team behind Michelin-recognized Koh Lipe. Grab-and-go concept — no table reservations offered (the site's own "Book a Table" link is broken/dead). Catering menu: https://kaokang.ca/cateringMenu.html. Two gift card options: a Toast gift card specific to Kao Kang (listed above), and The Well Gift Card (https://thewelltoronto.com/shop/the-well-gift-card/) usable across the whole Wellington Market food hall. A group-wide "Naguk Gift Card" redeemable across all Naguk-associated restaurants is mentioned on the site as coming soon but is not yet live.
